title: Exam Coach State
description: JSON Schema for data/state.json — the canonical structured state. The markdown files are rendered views/human annotations; this JSON is the source of truth. The dashboard is a deterministic build artifact derived from this file (see scripts/build-dashboard.mjs).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Increment on breaking changes. Current: '2.1' (adds readiness debias fields; loosens quizScore.correct to number).

fullName.description: Full exam name, e.g. 'AWS Solutions Architect Associate'

date.description: Exam date in YYYY-MM-DD, or null if ongoing

passMarkPercent.description: Pass mark as integer percent, e.g. 72 (not 0.72 — percent fields are 0–100, never 0–1). Interpretation depends on examProfile.scoring.model.

caseMode.description: How case patterns are sourced. Orthogonal to examProfile.scenarioRecallRatio (case sourcing axis, not scenario-vs-recall mix).

examProfile.description: MCQ exam descriptor. Parameterization axes that later tasks branch on. v2.0 defines the contract only — no branching logic is implemented yet. Defaults reproduce v1.x behavior.

profile.description: Exam family. Only 'mcq' is supported in scope (see README Scope section).

scenarioRecallRatio.description: Fraction of questions that are scenario-based vs recall. 1.0 = pure scenarios; 0.0 = pure recall. Generalizes the scenario-vs-recall mix; orthogonal to exam.caseMode (which describes case sourcing when ratio > 0).

mode.description: 'weighted' = honor declared weights (v1 default behavior). 'unweighted' = treat all domains equally. 'none' = no domain blueprint structure.

scoring.description: How exam.passMarkPercent is interpreted. Does not duplicate the pass mark — only describes its meaning.

model.description: 'fixed_percent' = raw % cutoff (v1 default). 'scaled' = passMarkPercent is the scaled-score equivalent (scaleMin/scaleMax describe the scale). 'pass_fail_unknown' = pass mark not published.

scaleMin.description: Lower bound of scaled-score range (e.g. 100 for AWS). Only meaningful when model='scaled'.

scaleMax.description: Upper bound of scaled-score range (e.g. 1000 for AWS). Only meaningful when model='scaled'.

optionCount.description: Number of answer options per question. Default 4.

multipleCorrect.description: True if questions may have multiple correct answers. Default false (single-correct).

partialCredit.description: Scoring policy when multipleCorrect is true. Default 'all_or_nothing'.

adaptive.description: Explicit out-of-scope guard. Adaptive / computerized-adaptive (CAT) exams are out of scope (see README Scope section).

domains.description: One entry per declared exam domain.

taskStatements.description: Task statement IDs covered by this domain

phases.description: One entry per study phase. Phases end in a phase exam.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, null if not yet reached

topics.description: Task statement IDs covered this day

correct.description: Raw correct count. Float allowed for partial-credit multi-correct scoring (e.g. 7.5).

calibration.description: Predicted-vs-actual log. One entry per quiz or phase exam.

label.description: Identifies the quiz/exam, e.g. 'Phase 1 exam' or 'Day 7 quiz'

misses.description: All miss entries. Each entry is stable — IDs never renumbered.

id.description: Stable ID assigned at creation, e.g. 'miss-0001'

label.description: Trap-name handle matching the misses.md entry label

domain.description: Domain ID, e.g. 'D1', or 'meta' for exam-grammar entries

watchlistPosition.description: Position in the Watchlist if onWatchlist is true

diagnostic.description: One-sentence question or handle for drilling this trap

watchlist.description: Derived from misses where onWatchlist=true. Sorted by position ascending. Maintained as a separate array for dashboard convenience.

readiness.description: Readiness snapshot. The coach owns coldWaterEstimatePercent (raw vibes-based estimate) and summary (prose). Everything else is computed by scripts/build-dashboard.mjs from calibration[] and the scoring model; do not write these by hand.

lastUpdated.description: Coach-owned: when the coach last updated coldWaterEstimatePercent or summary.

coldWaterEstimatePercent.description: Coach-owned: raw vibes-based blended cold-water estimate. The script applies bias correction (from calibration[]) to produce debiasedEstimatePercent — that is the number the dashboard headlines.

debiasedEstimatePercent.description: Script-computed: coldWaterEstimatePercent + biasCorrectionPercent, clamped to 0..100. Null if cold-water is null.

marginOverCutPercent.description: Script-computed: debiasedEstimatePercent - exam.passMarkPercent. Null for pass_fail_unknown scoring or when estimate is null.

noiseModelStdDevPercent.description: Script-computed when sampleSize ≥ 5 (observed stdev(calibration[].delta), clamped to a minimum of 3); otherwise the prior 7.

passProbabilityRoughEstimate.description: Script-computed: 1 - normalCDF((passMarkPercent - debiasedEstimatePercent) / noiseModelStdDevPercent). Null for pass_fail_unknown scoring or when estimate is null.

biasCorrectionPercent.description: Script-computed: mean(calibration[].delta) when sampleSize ≥ 5, else 0. Positive = student is systematically underconfident; negative = overconfident.

sampleSize.description: Script-computed: number of calibration[] entries used for bias/stdev. Below 5 the script falls back to bias=0 and the ±7% prior to avoid overfitting on small samples.

qualitativeBand.description: Script-computed qualitative readiness label for pass_fail_unknown scoring (e.g. 'Strong', 'Likely passing', 'Marginal', 'Weak'). Null for fixed_percent and scaled — those use the numeric probability.

summary.description: Coach-owned: one-sentence prose summary, e.g. '90-94% blended cold-water; 250-point margin over cut'.

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last state write, e.g. '2025-03-14T18:30:00Z'

path.description: Relative path from project root, e.g. 'sources/exam-guide.md'
